fusions.name: Leap From Cover
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles onto an enemy and bite it, which deals 14 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Rapid Nips
fusions.desc: Bites twice in quick succession; each bite deals 6 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Your movement speed rises 15% for 3 seconds after you use it. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Dropline Hop
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 7 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 3 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Coiled to Pounce
fusions.desc: Every time you dodge a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 5. The next ability you use spends them all: you deal 6% more damage per stack (30% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
